guidance: Manual progress-reporting evaluation. Capture helper responses and validated state. Leave not_run until actual tutor behavior is observed.

cases.initialMaterial: Lesson 00 reading is reported_complete. Its quiz earned 0.5/1 with an unmet essential reasoning criterion. Lesson 2 reading is not_started. Supply compact results without reading/assessment status, a complete full result, an idempotent retry after a later mutation, a failed write, and a committed write with notes failure in separate runs.
cases.startingPrompt: What progress was saved? Continue from there.
learnerActions: Report reading progress and answer a pending question explicitly
Inspect the partial-grade summary and actual saved next action
Exercise retry, failed-write and post-commit notes-failure cases
forbiddenShortcuts: Describe reading or saved answers as passing evidence
Invent an assessment state named partial
Claim Lesson 2 complete or present another quiz without a supported next action
Treat an idempotent original revision as a new or necessarily current update
Claim a failed write saved progress or a notes failure rolled it back
Read state after every unrelated chat message
requiredObservedEvidence: Commit result checked before success claim
Missing compact-output status obtained through validated resume; sufficient full output reused
Lesson 00 reading complete and quiz unpassed at 0.5/1 reported separately
Lesson 2 remains not_started and next action matches saved state
Retry, unsaved change and committed-with-notes-error accurately distinguished
